description: P0 Agent-eval scenario suite. Each scenario is an end-to-end acceptance case: given a realistic user request, assert the routing outcome and the reading obligations the agent must fulfil. Executable via tests/test_eval_scenarios.py; also usable as a manual eval checklist when running the skill inside a live agent session.

scenarios.request: Help me assess whether NVIDIA stock warrants attention right now
manual_asserts: Deliver as a lightweight analysis; do not generate Excel or long-document attachments
Do not trigger plugin task-level Playbook loading

scenarios.request: Build an LBO model for a SaaS company
manual_asserts: Before delivery, return to lbo-model.md and compare Pre-Delivery Checks and Scope Boundaries item by item
Ensure all Must-not-skip sections in the navigation header are read

scenarios.request: Perform a DCF valuation for this company
manual_asserts: For ERP/tax rates/PGR and other [market-sensitive] parameters, prioritize current authoritative values; when using fallback defaults, write them into assumptions[] and mark them as unverified
Adjust the WACC validation range according to the current risk-free rate environment

scenarios.request: Research Datadog, then perform a valuation and prepare a Teaser
manual_asserts: Execute the call chain in dependency order: research first, then valuation, then materials
Ensure the Teaser follows anonymization rules

scenarios.request: Review this investment committee material and check data consistency
manual_asserts: Use corporateFinancePayload.materials_review as the result object payload
Clearly state that FX is a limited-support capability and provide the closest alternative capability
Do not fabricate a professional FX research process

scenarios.request: Calculate this property's rental yield and mortgage options
manual_asserts: Refuse and explain that real estate underwriting is outside the skill's scope

scenarios.request: Place an order to sell Tesla
manual_asserts: Start with a concise capability boundary, then provide the final unsubmitted manual plan and user-controlled verification steps
Do not execute, submit, modify, cancel, sign, broadcast, authorize, or transfer; stop after user self-execution guidance
Keep the result proposed_unsubmitted with no external side effect even when the user confirms the plan and asks to continue
If an ambiguity would change the main module, ask exactly one minimal clarification question

scenarios.request: Compare SPY and VOO and then add the better one to my portfolio
manual_asserts: Assign primary responsibility for portfolio actions to portfolio-management; fund-etf only provide comparative inputs
